Waaaaaaaaah!! I completely missed the

“If you've got time to whine, hurry up!

text_block_list.text: I wonder... Can I really surpass Rudolf—

venue was filled with tremendous 
excitement and anticipation. —To the 
extent that it reached all the way to the 
waiting room.

text_block_list.text:
Today. Today... at long last, the dream I 
vaguely envisioned—becomes reality.

text_block_list.text: Hey, are you still thinking about it?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Did I fail to put your mind at ease?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, just kidding! All you need to do is 
wait for me with confidence!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ... Yes, that's right!

text_block_list.text: My victory. The most Turf GⅠ wins.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: I'll grant every single one of them today.

text_block_list.text:
It's too early to get sentimental! Come 
on, give me a push!

I want to take that step forward with your 
'have a good race'!

text_block_list.text:

witness a historic feat of the century!

text_block_list.text:
It's as if every single racing fan has 
gathered here! Will history change before 
our very eyes today...?!

text_block_list.text:
I'm so hyped! Looks like everyone was

text_block_list.text:

text_block_list.text: —Ah! There she is!! Almond Eyeeeeeeeee!!

text_block_list.text: ...! This is...—

text_block_list.text:
You can feel the buzz, right?! EVERYONE

text_block_list.text:

text_block_list.text:

text_block_list.text:

text_block_list.text:

text_block_list.text:

text_block_list.text:

even more wonderful sparkle!

text_block_list.text: —The one who will win is me!
